items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Then, uh, I like Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: Trombone? Uh, well, I'll have to say, uh, Archie Rogers, as far as I'm concerned, is one of the best in the city. I mean, maybe a lot of other people don't know that or have never heard him play. But personally, I think he's one of the best. Then, uh, Bob Havens is good. Bob Havens, uh, plays with Hurts Grove. He's good. Then, uh, I like Jim Robinson. I could go on, I could think of quite a few of them, but offhand, you know.
I just want you offhand. Yeah. I prefer to have that, you know, kind of.
